'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Battle of Bakhmut]]
***[[Wagner Group]] forces begin withdrawing from [[Bakhmut]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], transferring control over to the [[Russian Ground Forces]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-65705733 (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2023 inflation surge]]
**The [[Economy of Germany|German economy]] enters a [[recession]] for the first time since the [[COVID-19 pandemic]] amid high levels of [[inflation]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-65707206 (BBC News)]
*[[Modern immigration to the United Kingdom]]
**[[Net migration rate|Net migration]] to the [[United Kingdom]] reaches a record of 606,000, mostly due to non-[[European Union|EU]] arrivals, according to the [[Office for National Statistics]]. In response, [[Minister of State for Immigration]] [[Robert Jenrick]] reaffirmed the governments commitment "to reducing overall net migration to sustainable levels". [https://news.sky.com/story/net-migration-rises-to-new-record-figure-of-606-000-in-the-year-to-december-2022-12888478 (Sky News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Belarus–Russia relations]]
**[[Russian military presence in Belarus]]
***[[Russia]] and [[Belarus]] sign an agreement in [[Minsk]] allowing the stationing of Russian [[tactical nuclear weapon]]s on Belarusian territory. [[President of Belarus|Belarusian President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] says that the weapons are already being transferred to Belarus. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/russia-belarus-sign-document-tactical-nuclear-weapon-deployment-belarus-2023-05-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[Afghanistan–Iran relations]], [[Recognition of the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan]]
**[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian Foreign Minister]] [[Hossein Amir-Abdollahian]] says that [[Iran]] does not recognize the [[Taliban]] government in [[Afghanistan]] due to the lack of an inclusive [[government of Afghanistan|government]] as well as recent tensions between Iran and the Taliban over [[Afghanistan–Iran border|border]] [[2021 Afghanistan–Iran clashes|incidents]] and a dispute over the [[Helmand River]]. [https://english.news.cn/20230525/85b31390adb9434ba18d5d57d6c46a39/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack]]
**[[Criminal proceedings in the January 6 United States Capitol attack]]
***[[Oath Keepers]] founder [[Stewart Rhodes]] is sentenced to 18 years in prison for his role in the [[January 6 United States Capitol attack|2021 attacks]] on the [[United States Capitol|Capitol]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/05/25/politics/oath-keepers-sentencing-stewart-rhodes-kelly-meggs/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2023 Nagano attack]]
**A man kills four people in a shooting and stabbing attack in [[Nakano, Nagano|Nakano]], [[Nagano Prefecture]], [[Japan]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-65709901  (BBC News)]
*The [[Supreme Court of Russia]] orders the liquidation of the [[People's Freedom Party (Russia)|People's Freedom Party]], the oldest opposition party in the country. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2023/05/25/russia-dissolves-oldest-opposition-party-a81282 (''The Moscow Times'')]
*[[South African Police Service|Police]] in [[South Africa]] arrest [[Fulgence Kayishema]], who was indicted by the [[International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda]] in 2001 for his involvement in the [[Rwandan genocide]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/5/25/rwandan-genocide-suspect-kayishema-arrested-in-south-africa-u-n-tribunal (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Metropolitan Police|Police]] arrest a man after he crashed his car into the gates outside [[Downing Street]] in [[London]], which houses the official residences and offices of the [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|prime minister]] [[Rishi Sunak]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-65714508 (BBC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*The [[United States|U.S.]] [[Food and Drug Administration]] (FDA) approves [[Neuralink]]'s first-in-human clinical study of [[brain implant]]s to treat conditions such as [[paralysis]] and [[Visual impairment|blindness]]. [https://www.reuters.com/science/elon-musks-neuralink-gets-us-fda-approval-human-clinical-study-brain-implants-2023-05-25/ (Reuters)]
*A potent new [[antibiotic]], [[abaucin]], capable of killing ''[[Acinetobacter baumannii]]'' (one of three [[Antimicrobial resistance|superbugs]] the [[World Health Organization]] has identified as a "critical threat" to humanity), is created using [[Artificial intelligence|artificial intelligence]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/health-65709834 (BBC News)]
